limitations: Every status is a model visual judgment, not independent human agreement.
Accepted local traces count only selected evidence patches; their uncovered area is unknown.
State 0 is untraced, not confirmed absent; state 2 is a threshold band, not a confidence interval.
Fine screening may remain inseparable from capture sampling or material texture.
No full movie-content denominator, exhaustive semantic masks or false-negative validation.
Candidate fractions must not become universal redraw texture-area targets.
